newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine, Iran sign economic cooperation treaty.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine, Iran sign economic cooperation treaty.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati and his Ukrainian counterpart Hennady Udovenko signed an economic cooperation treaty on Monday in Kiev.
"The main goal of this treaty is to give a boost to trade and economic cooperation," Udovenko told a news conference.

Velayati, who was on a two-day official visit, said the two countries would hold discussions on Ukraine buying oil from Iran during a forthcoming visit to Tehran by Ukraine's state minister in charge of energy, Anatoly Minchenko.
Ukraine, which previously agreed to build Antonov An-140 turbo-prop aircraft with Iran, has been looking for alternate energy sources as it tries to wean itself off Russian supplies.
